title: Lead Software Developer - Java FS Angular
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking a **Lead Software Developer** to strengthen a product lifecycle platform built with Java, Angular, Kafka, and PostgreSQL. You will help embed AI Ops and AI SDLC in an AI\-native delivery flow while operating within a scalable microservices architecture supporting industrial volumes.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and sustain the product lifecycle platform implemented with Java, Angular, and PostgreSQL
* Help scale and enhance a microservices architecture built for industrial\-grade performance
* Implement engineering standards and CI/CD practices throughout delivery
* Enable service integrations through REST APIs and other communication links
* Safeguard reliability across a 24/5 operating model, including 24/7 coverage for P1/P2 incidents
* Review code and collaborate on testing activities with peers
* Use feedback to improve outcomes and ask questions that surface risks early
* Adjust to rapid change while adopting modern engineering methods

**Requirements**

* Comprehensive 8–12 years of experience in Java Full Stack development with Angular
* Practical expertise in REST APIs plus service\-to\-service communication
* Demonstrated experience following engineering standards and CI/CD processes
* Team\-oriented mindset with a positive response to constructive feedback
* Meticulous attention to detail when working on high\-availability services
* English proficiency of B2 (Upper\-Intermediate) or higher

**Nice to have**

* Working knowledge of Kafka, PostgreSQL, or Elasticsearch
* Familiarity with hexagonal architecture and microservices architecture patterns
* Experience with structured code review and testing practices in delivery teams

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)
